tex_content.label: gt-conv-8-weak-zeroth-order-sign
tex_content.html: \begin{convention} \end{convention}[Weak nonpositivity of the zeroth-order term] 1. ch8:8.8\group ch08-generalized-solutions The generalized sign condition corresponding to $D_ib^i+d\leq 0$ is \begin{equation} \int _\Omega (dv-b^iD_iv)\, dx\leq 0 \qquad \forall v\in C_0^1(\Omega ),\quad v\geq 0. \tag {8.8} \end{equation} Under (8.6), it also holds for nonnegative $v\in W_0^{1,1}(\Omega )$. \end{convention}
